Long-term residents

Long-Term Payments

Choose the resident, select the number of weeks being paid, then enter the Electricity amount. Rent, weekly supply and Extras are saved weekly amounts and are calculated automatically.
Do not use the whole RMS account balance. RMS can generate future charges ahead of payment. This calculator uses the resident's saved weekly Accommodation, Supply and Extras rates for only the number of weeks selected. Staff only enter the Electricity amount to include now.

2. RMS sub-account split

These are the three amounts staff enter into the three RMS sub-accounts. Accommodation combines the saved rent and weekly supply charge.
Accommodation
Rent + weekly supply charge, multiplied by the selected weeks.
Enter in Accommodation$0.00
Extras
Saved weekly Extras amount × selected weeks.
Enter in Extras$0.00
Electricity
The only variable amount. Enter the Electricity amount from RMS for this payment.
Enter in Electricity$0.00

🚨 Emergency Information

An emergency could be fire, lockdown or other harmful situation that requires either an emergency directed to an evacuation point or where guests are advised to stay inside (lockdown).

Directions for emergencies:

  1. Notify all in-house guests
  2. Print guest-in house list
  3. Assist with emergency efforts
